fusions.name: Caldera
fusions.desc: Splits the ground around you with molten rock, which deals 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignores armour and sets each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Magma Knuckle
fusions.desc: A blow with a fist of half-molten rock that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to set it [Burning] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Basalt Ridge
fusions.desc: Raises a ridge of lava rock 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 6 seconds. Anything that touches it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cooling Crust
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
